notes.title: Release of The Alchemist on Steam + Kickstarter
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I'm Azephir, the creator of The Alchemist.
The Alchemist was released on Itch about 6 months ago and now it is available on Steam.
There are no big changes between the 2 versions, except for the Steam achievements.

I'm very proud to release my first game on Steam and for those of you who haven't played The Alchemist yet, I hope you will enjoy it.

This first week of release, the game is 40% off. This discount is both for this release and for the last week of my kickstarter.

Indeed, I've launched a Kickstarter for my upcoming game, which will end on the night of Friday, July 1 to Saturday, July 2.
Your support will be greatly appreciated: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/azephir/the-magic-mediator

Also, feel free to leave a comment or a rating of the game: that's how Steam visibility works ;-)

Thank you, 

Cheers,

Azephir
